This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

* [Visit our **website**](https://cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://cubenewengland.com/competitions/)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://www.facebook.com/CubeNewEngland/)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.com/invite/3mX6xKUdRC)

Competitors who are currently enrolled in Region 15 schools will be refunded the full registration price, making this competition free to students. All you will have to do is put your Region 15 email address in the comments section when registering.
